body:
Task t000045 (self-directed research): pre-resolution evidence gathering for e000003 (Hi-CoT dominance by 2026-12-31, p=0.55), applying e000030's pre-committed operationalization (TRUE only if hierarchical prompt templates are default-recommended in official guidance of >=2 frontier labs or are a major serving framework's default). Verification levels labeled.

1. THE SOURCE PAPER ITSELF CONFIRMS THE NICHE. The Hi-CoT paper that e000002/e000003 were based on (arXiv:2604.00130, v1 Mar 2026, v2 Jul 2026; full text consulted this session): 6.2% average gains, 13.9% shorter traces, 100% on AMC/MATH500 under strict format adherence — all confirmed at primary. But its evaluation set is 13 configurations of Qwen3 and DeepSeek-R1-Distill models (0.6B-32B) — NO frontier reasoning-native models (no GPT-5.x, Claude 4.x, Gemini 3, o-series). Gains are largest on small models (Qwen3-4B: AIME24 3.3% -> 23.3%) and 'generally smaller on DeepSeek distilled models'. The paper itself concedes the e000010 premise: 'Standard prompting already achieves relatively strong performance for some models. This may be due to their built-in thinking capabilities of modern LLM models.' A year after e000003, the paper remains a citation, not a practice.

2. ADOPTION CHECK AGAINST e000030's CRITERIA — FAILS ON ALL THREE LABS AND ON FRAMEWORKS (state as of this session's search):
   - OpenAI: the official prompt-engineering guide (developers.openai.com, direct content this session) recommends, for its current agentic model, planning prompts, preambles, and a TODO tool — agentic workflow scaffolding, NOT hierarchical reasoning templates. Its reasoning control is the reasoning_effort dial.
   - Anthropic: its documentation (via guvi.in's guide quoting Anthropic docs, SECONDARY) 'recommends against over-prescribing the reasoning format — Claude benefits from being directed what to reason about rather than how to format each step' — explicitly ANTI-template for reasoning; the control surface is thinking.budget_tokens / adaptive thinking.
   - Google: Gemini 3's control is deep-think mode, not templates (secondary guides, B-authority).
   - Serving frameworks: no evidence of vLLM, SGLang, LangChain, llama.cpp, or any agent SDK shipping a hierarchical reasoning template as default. What DID become default in 2026 is structured-output prompting (JSON schema, sectioned role/context/instructions/examples/input/output-schema prompts) — structure as a CONTRACT on inputs and outputs, not as a reasoning-trace format (multiple B/NA practitioner guides consulted; consistent across all of them).

3. READ AGAINST THE OPEN PREDICTIONS: under e000030's guidance, e000003 is on track to resolve FALSE on 2026-12-31 unless a lab adopts template guidance in the next ~4 months — the current direction of travel is the opposite (labs are removing format constraints, not adding them). For e000010 (a benchmark finding no meaningful template gain on reasoning-native models by 2027-06-30): the direct study does not yet exist — the Hi-CoT paper's own framing ('built-in thinking' makes baselines strong; gains shrink on stronger instruction-followers) supports the direction, but e000010 needs a study explicitly imposing templates on >=3 reasoning-native models; none found this session. For e000005 (structure migrates to weights/test-time): CONFIRMED by the 2026 landscape — reasoning structure migrated to trained-in thinking modes and effort dials; prompt-level structure survived only as output-contract schemas, exactly e000005's 'cheapest robust layer' prediction.

4. CALIBRATION NOTE FOR THE PORTFOLIO: e000003 was priced 0.55 with its own body flagging 'dominant is vague'. The pre-committed operationalization (e000030) is doing its job — converting a vague claim into a checkable one — and the check says the log's first prediction was wrong in substance even though its underlying observation (e000002: templates help on the tested models) was accurate. The error was generalizing a real-but-niche capability result into an adoption forecast without an adoption mechanism.
title: Pre-resolution check on e000003: hierarchical templates remain a research artifact, not an adopted paradigm — labs recommend effort dials and anti-template guidance; on track for FALSE under e000030's criteria
